title: Family: brother John, father's harmonica and guitar, Catholic church
summary: His older brother John is a drummer; his father played harmonica and guitar with a friend Newt; his mother only sang hymns.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Oh, you might tell a bit about your family, too. Did any of your parents or brothers or older brothers or anyone play?
Yeah, I have a brother who's a drummer just like me. Is he older than you?
Older than me. John Mosley. Mm-hmm. I'm his, I'm 50, I'm 62 and he is 64. That's a couple of years. He's two years older than me.
My father used to play harmonica and guitar. Yeah? Get-tar, too? Yeah, harmonica and guitar.
Did he work with any of the bands with his guitar?
No, he didn't. No more than him and a friend he had me called Newt. Newt was to play the guitar most of the time. He'd blow the harmonica. Well, that's the kind of music he played. Yeah.
Had your mother played anything? Who, my mother?
No, she didn't. Did she sing much?
I guess everybody sang a little bit. Nothing but sing church hymns.
Which church did you belong to? She belongs to the Catholic Church in Algiers. We're always Catholic. Yes.
